newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX 2.45 pct lower, looks to U.S.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX 2.45 pct lower, looks to U.S.

text.p: A jittery German market was 2.40 percent down in afternoon electronic trade on Friday, fearful of what would happen on Wall Street on opening after U.S. chip maker Intel Corp issued a profit warning.
By 1311 GMT the IBIS DAX index was down 85.64 points at 3,549.74 points, while the June DAX future contract was down 78.5 points at 3,559.5 points.
Dealers said that a combination of factors led to the slide, including fears of a Wall Street slide, uncertainty about the future of EMU, debt market weakness and impending elections in France.

"We're seeing the impact of the whole picture here. We had Intel, there's the EMU uncertainty after the Waigel/Bundesbank row, the elections in France. Also there aren't many people around today, because of the holiday yesterday," a Munich trader said.

Intel said that revenues and net income in its fiscal second quarter would fall below expectations due to weaker-than-projected demand, while athletic footwear and apparel company Nike Inc also issued a profit warning.
A Frankfurt broker said: "We are waiting for the U.S. numbers at the moment. There's a lot of uncertainty about."

The Nike profit warning hit sportswear maker Puma AG particularly hard, with the share down 3.50 marks, or 6.25 percent, at 52.50 marks, while Adidas was down 9.70 marks, over five percent, at 179.50 marks.
Otherwise, losses in the share market did not really restrict themselves to particular sectors, though some were hit worse than others.
"The chemicals have been hit hard, and the future has come off considerably, which suggests that there is a lot of derivative-led trade out there at the moment," the broker said.
BASF AG was down 1.06 marks at 62.94 marks, Bayer AG was down 1.28 marks at 66.80 marks, while Hoechst AG was down 2.35 marks at 66.15 marks.
Among other big losers were car stocks BMW AG, which was down 37 marks at 1,393 marks, while Porsche was down 129.90 marks at 2,060 marks.
Shares in construction group Hochtief AG were down six marks at 72 marks.
